Subject: Proposal: mid-contract capacity cadence & uplift options

Jordan —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, attached is a concise uplift matrix and three execution paths for scaling capacity mid-contract so you can pick the cadence that best fits Fractalo’s runway. High level:

- Option A — Single top-up (one-time increase): +20% capacity => 6% uplift discount; billed pro-rata on next invoice.
- Option B — Staged quarterly top-ups: +10% now, +10% next quarter => 4% immediate discount + 2% on second installment.
- Option C — Annualize & co-term: convert added capacity into a co-term annual commit with blended discount of 8% (requires co-term to 2027-01-31).

I attached the working matrix (20260704-fractalo-uplift-matrix.xlsx) that shows unit economics at each band, and a draft amendment we can use to land the paperwork quickly. Quick asks: can you confirm whether procurement prefers a single amendment or a PO + SOW flow, and whether your legal needs a tracked Word draft?

If helpful, Ben can demo the invoicing flow and Marissa will propose an amendment that preserves your existing committed discount floor. If you have a target effective date (e.g., start of next billing cycle), let us know and we’ll align proration.

Best,

Kimberly Park

Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the clear options. A few quick clarifying questions before I share with procurement: 

1) Does the uplift discount in Options A/B/C stack on top of our existing committed discount, or does it replace it for the increased capacity only?
2) How is billing handled if we do a staged top-up (Option B)? Do you bill pro-rata for the added portion each quarter or consolidate on the next full invoice?
3) Is there an upper cap on cumulative discounts if we continue to top up through the year?

Procurement asked if you can provide a one-page summary for our legal review and to confirm they prefer co-terminating to 2027-01-31 if we go the annualize route. Also copying procurement contact so they have the matrix.

Subject: Re: Proposal: mid-contract capacity cadence & uplift options

Jordan — thanks for the rapid turn. Answers inline below and attached a one-page summary and a tracked-draft amendment for legal: one-pager-uplift-summary.pdf; redwood-amendment-draft.docx

1) Discount stacking: the uplift discount is applied only to the incremental capacity band and does not reduce the existing committed discount on your baseline. In practice you keep your current floor rate for existing committed units; the uplift bands receive the incremental discount shown in the matrix. (Example included in the spreadsheet.)

2) Staged billing (Option B): each top-up installment is billed pro-rata on the next invoice after the increase goes live. We do not back-bill prior months. If you prefer consolidation to a single invoice at the end of the quarter we can accommodate, but it requires a brief SOW note; Karthik is copied to confirm the invoicing cadence and whether consolidation affects tax/PO handling.

3) Cap: there is a negotiated maximum aggregate uplift discount of 12% across additional capacity in any 12-month window. We included a fail-safe in the amendment language to preserve unit economics if volumes exceed model thresholds.

Next steps I suggest:
- Procurement: review the one-pager and the tracked amendment.
- Jordan: confirm target effective date (we can do immediate pro-rata on next invoice or align to start of your next billing cycle).
- Karthik: please confirm the billing flow and whether we should prepare a consolidated invoice option for Fractalo.

If procurement wants a redline in Word, we’ll send that by EOD Monday.

Thanks —
Kimberly

Subject: Re: Proposal: mid-contract capacity cadence & uplift options (billing confirmation)

Team — quick confirmation on invoicing:

- Staged top-ups (Option B): we will bill each incremental top-up pro-rata on the next invoice following the effective date of the increase. That is the default and keeps POs aligned to discrete changes.
- Consolidated quarterly invoicing: we can produce a single consolidated invoice at month-end if the customer prefers; flag this at signing so we can route through finance and adjust tax code handling.
- Co-term (Option C): if Fractalo co-terms to 2027-01-31, we will produce an amendment that restates the new annualized commit and issues a one-time adjustment line on the following invoice to reconcile prior pro-rata charges.

I will prepare the invoicing note and a short field guide for CS/Finance (how to reconcile pro-rata lines) and drop it in the HubSpot record once Kimberly confirms the chosen path.
